title: Positive display polarity and reading speed and accuracy
statement:
Positive display polarity (dark text on a light background) yields faster and more accurate reading for both younger and older adults by reducing pupil size and increasing visual acuity.

Options:
- Positive Polarity: Dark grey text (#333333) on white (#FFFFFF) (fits: standard web, ecommerce, editorial)
- High Contrast Positive: Pure black text (#000000) on white (#FFFFFF) (fits: accessibility first, low vision tools)
- Negative Polarity (Dark Mode): Light text on dark background (fits: developer tools, low light environments, aesthetic choice)
- User-Selected Polarity: System-level prefers-color-scheme toggle (fits: modern web apps, SaaS)
appliesWhen: Applies to: web, mobile apps, dark mode design. Audience: general, adults, seniors.

source.title: Positive display polarity is advantageous for both younger and older adults
source.authors: Cornelia Piepenbrock; Susanne Mayr; Axel Buchner
